description: Complex artifact-iteration evals (long-memory, design, destructive iteration). Drive each scenario's turns through the real chat UI against a sandbox stack (see docs/feedback-loops/artifact-iteration-filtering.md for the harness), then score with scorer.py. Architecture-neutral: scores the coder-based and planner-authored pipelines identically.

scenarios.title: Long-memory iteration (12 turns)
turns: Using the Chinook Music Store: create a granular revenue dataset from invoice lines with columns for invoice date, genre name, customer country, artist name and album title.

Build a dashboard titled 'Memory Gauntlet' from this data. PERMANENT DESIGN RULE #1: the KPI row (total revenue and invoice count) is always the FIRST section, above everything else. Also include a monthly revenue trend line chart and a revenue-by-genre bar chart.
PERMANENT DESIGN RULE #2: all accent colors on this dashboard are indigo (#6366f1) - never change this unless I say so.
Add a table of the top 10 artists by revenue at the bottom.
Rename the monthly trend section heading to 'Momentum'.
Add a genre filter that re-runs the data server-side across every chart and the KPIs.
Give all cards rounded-xl corners and a subtle border.
Add a third KPI card: distinct customer count.
Remove the revenue-by-genre bar chart - we don't need it.
Also add a customer-country filter, same server-side behavior as the genre filter.
Make the artists table header row bold with a slate background.
Tighten the vertical spacing between sections a bit.

scenarios.title: Complex one-shot design build
turns: Using the Chinook Music Store: create one wide granular revenue dataset from invoice lines with invoice date, genre, customer country, customer id, artist, album, unit price and quantity.

Build a dashboard titled 'Chinook Executive Suite' with ALL of the following: a KPI row with four cards (total revenue, invoice count, distinct customers, average order value); a monthly revenue trend line chart; a top-10 artists horizontal bar chart; a revenue-by-genre donut chart; and a recent-invoices table. Add TWO global filters - genre and customer country - as server-side query parameters with an All option that re-run the data at the source. Dark slate theme with indigo accents, fully responsive.

scenarios.title: Destructive iteration / regression gauntlet (8 turns)
turns: Using the Chinook Music Store: create a granular revenue dataset from invoice lines with invoice date, genre, customer country and artist.
Build a dashboard titled 'Gauntlet' with: a total-revenue KPI, a monthly trend line, a revenue-by-genre bar chart, and a genre filter that re-runs the data server-side everywhere.
Add a top-10 artists table that respects the same genre filter.
Restyle the KPI card: emerald accent, large number.
Remove the monthly trend line chart.
Rename the dashboard to 'Gauntlet Prime'.
Add back a monthly revenue trend, as an area chart this time.
Make the genre filter default to 'All' and double-check every section still responds to it.
